subject: How Do We Drain the Swamp? – From Mississippi’s Leading Conservative Think Tank
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/successsequence-11572040?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**America is now six months away from a Presidential election.** If current polls are correct and Donald Trump comes out ahead in the key battleground states, we could soon see a conservative in the White House, and a conservative-controlled Senate and House.
---
|
---
_Will conservatives control the White House and Congress?_

| It is one thing to gain power. It is quite another to know what to do with it. **Conservatives who try to run the federal government without a clear strategy in place soon end up being run by the federal government. **

Without a plan to drain the swamp, conservatives will find that they are in office, but not in power. Why is this so?

**The administrative state, with its vast alphabet soup of federal agencies, is fundamentally un-conservative.** Some might even say anti-conservative.

That is not to say that there is some sort of Deep State conspiracy against conservatives. (Federal officials struggle to issue visas or approve new medicines on a timely basis. I highly doubt they are competent enough to engage in conspiracies).
---
|
---
_What is the Deep State? _
| No, the problem is the mindset of those that work for the administrative state. Or, what the French call “déformation professionnelle.”

**Those that work for big government bureaucracies tend to favor more government.** If your career is spent working for a federal agency, you will perhaps see federal fiat as the answer, whatever the question.

Many of those that work for the government are very smart. Smart enough, in fact, to fall for the conceit that you can successfully engineer social and economic outcomes from above.

**Now that Diversity, Equity & Inclusion has become the official ideology of America’s public institutions, federal officials likely find it easier to implement “diversity strategies” and talk about “microaggressions” than deliver competent government.**
---
|
---
_‘Woke’ dogma is official ideology. Those who don’t subscribe are denounced. _
| Being part of a national bureaucracy in Washington makes you more inclined to want to work closely with supranational bureaucracies such as the UN, WHO, or the EU.

**What can an incoming conservative administration do about all this?** It is not enough to instruct the administrative state to govern differently. We need a plan to re-wire the administrative state itself. Here’s how:

** 1\. Find the Right People.**

**Donald Trump’s decision to appoint Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, and Amy Coney Barrett to the Supreme Court proved to be one of the most consequential things he has done. **As a result, the US Supreme Court now has a conservative majority for the first time since before the Warren Court, if not before.
---
|
---
_Amy Coney Barrett appointed to the Supreme Court_
| Trump did not appoint the right people to the Supreme Court because he happened to know them. It was the Federalist Society that identified and vetted suitable candidates for him.

I am delighted to be (a small) part of a project run by the Heritage Foundation and others to help identify the right people not so much for judicial appointments, but for positions across government. **Unless conservatives find the right people to install in the myriad of federal agencies, those that work in those agencies will nominate their own and little will change.**

** 2\. Shrink the Federal Machine. **

**Argentina’s new President Milei almost halved the number of government departments in the week after he took office.** U.S. conservatives should do something similar.
---
|
---
_Argentina’s Milei has shrunk the size of government._
| **Do we really need a US Department of Education (created in 1980) or federal Housing department (1965)?** Surely education and housing are matters that can be left to each state?

Why stop there? **There are currently 438 US federal agencies and sub-agencies. Conservatives should go full Milei on them.**

** 3\. Control the spending.**

What is the single biggest threat to the United States? It’s not China or Islamism. It is the ballooning national debt. **The US national debt is now growing by $1 trillion every 100 days.**

Conservatives urgently need to bring federal spending under control.
---
|
---
_Debt is a big threat to America’s future._
| Remember that kerfuffle a few months back when Rep Kevin McCarty tried and failed to be elected House Speaker dozens of times? One of the objections that the conservative refuseniks had was the fact that Congress did not seem to control federal spending.

**The process by which Congress approves federal budgets is far too convoluted. **One committee approves agriculture budgets, another defense, and so on. This makes it easier for various vested interests to ensure that their preferred spending items get approved.

**We need to return to the principle that there is some form of unified Congressional budgetary oversight. **This is the only chance of restoring Congressional control over the administrative state’s spending.

** 4\. Return authority to the states.**

The 10th Amendment clearly states that “powers not delegated to the United States by the Constitution, nor prohibited by it to the States, are reserved to the States respectively, or to the people.”

**Since the days of Woodrow Wilson, there has been a creeping coup that has seen federal agencies, abetted by the Supreme Court, usurp the primacy of the states.** Until now.

---
|
---
_Woodrow Wilson's creeping coup led to the growth of government._
| In a little noticed ruling in 2022, in West Virginia v. the Environmental Protection Agency, the Supreme Court essentially said that a federal agency could not presume to make policy the way the EPA was trying to. The ruling puts a question mark over the presumption that Congress has delegated major political and economic questions to executive agencies.

Conservatives need to build on this, and other similar rulings, to push back against decades of self-aggrandizement by federal agencies.

**How often do conservative voters vote for conservative leaders, but end up with more soft-left statism?** I would argue that this has been a constant feature of U.S. politics for over half a century, with a brief break from business as usual when Ronald Reagan was in the White House for 8 years in the 1980s.

Unless we are to see more of the same, we need to ensure that if and when conservatives gain control of the federal government, they use their one chance to achieve fundamental, strategic change to the way America is run. There may never be another.

Our aim must not be just to oust liberals, or even to install a particular leader. **Our goal should be to renew America by overturning the incremental coup that has created in Washington DC an administrative state that our Founders never envisioned and never sanctioned.**

Have a wonderful Easter!

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1285%2E135344%2EiCRM1d)

In 2020, Donald Trump made more visits to Michigan than almost any other state in the country.
Tuesday, he's coming back to speak at the DeVos Convention Center in Grand Rapids. It will already be his 4th trip in the 2024 race -- and his first after weighing in on the Michigan Senate race by endorsing Mike Rogers to be the Republican nominee.
So what does his trip mean?
First, let's state the obvious: there is no winning the White House in 2024 without winning Michigan. That goes for Joe Biden, and that goes for Donald Trump.
So this trip will be the next of many because Trump knows he needs to keep his supporters consistently motivated between now and November. Every time he visits he gets more volunteer activity and he gets more media attention -- both things he wants for his campaign.
It's also a chance for him to rally and organize more Michigan donors, the small-dollar ones and the deep-pocketed ones that will fund huge independent expenditures in the state.
All of this deeply impacts our race.
If someone turns out for Trump, there is a decent chance they are turning out for the Republican nominee in our Senate race.
But we are not powerless in all of this.
Because every person we turn out in our race is also likely a vote to keep Trump out of the White House. And the truth is, we have always done better than most Democrats do in some of those "redder" parts of the state.
So this is a big moment for us. We need to do our best to match the energy Trump generates for Republicans in Michigan, especially with our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline on March 31st. Because it is not just our race and control of the Senate for Democrats on the line in Michigan, but it's also the White House.

As we look ahead to the upcoming election year, it's abundantly clear that we stand at a critical juncture in our nation's history. The time has come for us to reclaim the true essence of America and restore the values that have made our country great. In 2024, we have a solemn duty to take America back from the forces that seek to undermine our freedoms and erode our national identity. We must stand united in defense of liberty, justice, and the American way of life. It's time to reject the radical agenda that threatens to tear our nation apart and reaffirm our commitment to the principles that have guided us for generations. Together, we can forge a brighter future for America—one rooted in strength, unity, and prosperity. Let us rise to the occasion and work tirelessly to reclaim the promise of this great land. **The fight to Take America Back starts now,** and I am honored to stand shoulder to shoulder with each and every one of you in this noble endeavor. This request comes at a very important time for our campaign, for Arizona, and for our country.
#

Good morning, Peter.
I’m reaching out to humbly ask if you could please make a $3 contribution to my campaign for Senate today.
This request comes at an absolutely critical time for our campaign, for Arizona, and for our country. Please, let me explain:
I didn’t agree with John McCain on much, but I respected him and his service. Both in the Navy, and in public life. At the end of the day, he was a good man and Arizonans were lucky to have him.
He used to represent the Republican Party in Arizona.
Today, Kari Lake is the Republican Party in Arizona. Someone who will do or say whatever she has to if it gets her elected. Who attacks our democracy at every turn and lies, spins conspiracies, and is Trump’s loudest, proudest advocate.
Now, if you’re with me and you’re ready to stop Kari Lake before she gains anymore power and influence, please:
[**Make that $3 contribution and help me win this race before our FEC deadline hits at midnight tomorrow.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar24.sAuZhx&refcode=em240330-1-160&t=1&akid=2142%2E734936%2ER7jVzZ)

Whether we win or not is going to depend on whether we raise the resources we need to do it.

I spent a lot of time writing it and did my best to make every word count. If you don't read it, nobody will. **First, there is no question in my mind that Joe Biden and his family are guilty of corruption.** I've presented mountains of evidence confirming Joe Biden's involvement in his family's influence peddling scheme, and I just had a group of the Biden family's business confidants publicly testify about the first family's criminal activity. _**At any other time in history, that would have been the final nail in the coffin of the Biden Crime Family's reign of corruption.**_
| [ **STAND WITH COMER** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=2e28c091deb2436680f91c236aece839&_e=lrJAisO-ji04cbh7iP8tfrYR1iZO0JXWnBZgSDw21MeTfFOycrXnjPiBMOWqmq4Qiawt2E8-VdWf4ZVh2RlvXQPTIlIoE7m2mUcPCyUsm0nRdu6IoBUg8uWmV7aE2ktyfLMjcbjorH_3IkUfneKUJ7BTEUa9NrZl-ZEZM2dSFMLMhx_O9lAJ_mlsp-v9b_ZFL3w7CvCWT4hZT-W4qLYikE8kioJLTxPtRmirSeH7DxvTAaFYCCMA-0xj4vOpSgOhl4pX33teI0i-Pgl8lmq2U3nvaha8d1XYhSxWYhl0IxbSfy92p9vqjea_LCBbD6TQMmv-2m1OYxsRiFV9Q7NQGkj48sEboVAjPnacRghtWFwXrLhYw-9IPj5C0nDzPehuyB5ibOJVCmI9QbBD481xRCp2seoRDB9h-sQl5yj1ZSc%3D)

But we are not in a normal time in history, we are in a defining moment where our country will either return to the rule of law being applied equally to everyone, or we will continue down this Orwellian path and the destruction of the American ideal. As it stands right now, the deranged Democrats are refusing to take up the Impeachment Trial of Alejandro Mayorkas and threatening to dismiss it within minutes when it finally is brought up. **Even "centrist" Democrats called the Mayorkas Impeachment Trial "ridiculous" just days after a criminal illegal brutally murdered Laken Riley in cold blood.** _What do you think they would do if we Impeached Biden?_ It's clear that Democrats will choose their party over their country and the truth at every turn. | [ **STAND WITH COMER** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=2e28c091deb2436680f91c236aece839&_e=lrJAisO-ji04cbh7iP8tfrYR1iZO0JXWnBZgSDw21MeTfFOycrXnjPiBMOWqmq4Qiawt2E8-VdWf4ZVh2RlvXQPTIlIoE7m2mUcPCyUsm0nRdu6IoBUg8uWmV7aE2ktyfLMjcbjorH_3IkUfneKUJ7BTEUa9NrZl-ZEZM2dSFMLMhx_O9lAJ_mlsp-v9b_ZFL3w7CvCWT4hZT-W4qLYikE8kioJLTxPtRmirSeH7DxvTAaFYCCMA-0xj4vOpSgOhl4pX33teI0i-Pgl8lmq2U3tQ9x59WtHcGGclBA5dP1PyPwqXmxmotIlq0RTAh5aCDyzEBmRIU__Xiu6B-XX9zalxDLyM95zFpwemstjHkof2_7qgd9drc-SnhH77w5fi864RMTX-DYaqkdWU2paLU2bTCcqY1Lmo3lx2oognrVs%3D)

I am dead serious when I tell you that the Democrats in D.C. only care about one thing. They don't care about the Constitution, the Rule of Law, or even their sacred oaths of office. Friend, Every year on March 30, Palestinians commemorate Land Day. This marks a day 48 years ago when Palestinians protested against the Israeli government’s illegal theft of Palestinian land. Israeli forces opened fire on the protesters, killing six people. On Land Day six years ago, when Palestinians in Gaza led the peaceful Great March of Return, Israeli soldiers killed hundreds and injured thousands of people. Despite years of mass displacement and erasure, Palestinians’ connection to the land of Palestine is still strong. It’s a link to our identity, to our Indigenous traditions and culture. The olive tree is a symbol of that steadfastness, and when Israeli soldiers and settlers destroy olive trees or set fire to agricultural land and crops in Palestine, it’s an attempt to sever the relationship that Palestinian people have with the land. **This year on Land Day, millions of people will march around the world, demanding an end to genocide, an end to apartheid and occupation, and for Palestinian refugees’ internationally recognized right of return.** **Click here to find a protest near you today:**[**https://www.shutitdown4palestine.org/actions**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMfXfe5hpfMSvVooRS5Mp3GZrxWNY5zBMseQ2UUTyPW8AkFTLzRR6cyT1_m-EYYm9UnoB5qZ1lcJ4ynlq6kY53o3tUgU28g70wuGHLGnT6mP-H-VfAuhgkzBLiR1b0UIdBGXNXLEe9_EijfDzReQ9E7UJ-sF7Kz5H4q63WOrDsihIlQ99KJGHuSWcrhFTrRZyarsAbWmZOm05DF3ghEX6p7XKaBPPyY8eglvb0RXWUWsbYFjt2Xtgt8hkJ74osEwMvFq4aLsj4F1i6819T7EGLIxu3X4CgobiQCTNP9eF_QRSOLbyiRCNYzGr7pUX8FPbm0TgIlsWIw7oz9mRSFV2r2VFCUNKMflapJJGodWrYy_X/453/yiDHF-atSNOv8v1p3L-OsA/h1/h001.3O0VRcF5-ZpLOR5jAnHxRoiv6kFv2dVDOoyZT8UTOys)**.** **If you can’t find or attend an action near you, please keep posting and talking about Palestine.** It matters, and it’s shifting public opinion: A new Gallup poll found that a majority of Americans oppose the Israeli military’s actions. We must keep the pressure on and demand the U.S. government stop its unconditional support for Israel's oppressive apartheid system, which treats Palestinians as less than human. This past week, the UN International Court of Justice ordered the “unhindered provision” of humanitarian assistance into Gaza. This is binding international law, as is the UN Security Council’s recent binding resolution for a temporary ceasefire. But Israel’s government continues to violate and ignore international law, blocking lifesaving aid for millions of Palestinians facing starvation, killing hundreds of people gathering for aid deliveries, and continuing the relentless bombing that has killed over 14,000 children. **This must end now. UN member countries must enforce these laws and save lives—especially the United States.** The U.S. is the top provider of military aid to Israel. A new report found that 70% of all arms imported by Israel are from the U.S. Instead of using this leverage to demand an end to the genocide, Congress and the White House just secured a new law sending billions of American tax dollars to Israel’s military and cutting off essential aid for Palestinians in Gaza. **Keep the pressure on. name: Hill Harper
subject: I need to be frank with you, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
And I’m humbly asking that you hear me out.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1123%2E62735%2EAIzUMV)
Hey Peter —
I know candidates far and wide are sending a lot of fundraising emails right now, asking for your support ahead of tomorrow’s end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. It seems like everyone's clamoring for our attention and contributions these days.
To be completely honest, asking for your money is my least favorite part of running for office. But I do need to be frank with you about what’s at stake: **This FEC deadline is our campaign’s biggest test yet.**
After our fundraising numbers go public, ALL eyes will be on us to see if we have what it takes to win this high-stakes Senate race. We’re running an outsider campaign, and everyone will be looking for signs of weakness as we go head-to-head with the establishment.
**So I want you to know how grateful I am to have you by my side through my biggest challenge yet.**
You believe that a better future is possible — one where healthcare is a right, workers earn the wages they deserve, and our children receive the best possible education. You believe in putting _people_ first, not corporate interests. **And you know that real change starts from the ground up — not with the wealthy and powerful at the top.**
That’s why we aren’t funded by corporate PACs or beholden to special interests. Instead, we rely on the strength of our grassroots supporters to keep us going. Every contribution we receive right now will help us hire more field organizers, connect with more voters, and grow our movement into a winning campaign.
**[So, I'm humbly asking for your support ahead of tomorrow’s deadline, Peter. Please, chip in any amount that works for you to help hit our $25,000 end-of-quarter goal.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1012?t=2&akid=1123%2E62735%2EAIzUMV)**

Breaking: Jack Smith's Case Against Trump Should Be Dismissed >>

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWtZPs_iN8

Fellow Patriot,
We filed a major amicus brief to
support former President Trump's motion to dismiss the indictment
in the case brought by Special Counsel Jack Smith related to the
FBI's raid of President Trump's Mar-a-Lago home.
Our novel legal brief
demonstrates how the National Archives & Records Administration
(NARA) decisions were not in accordance with the law and in
excess of its statutory authority. The court recognized the
importance of our argument and will now consider it in President
Trump's case.
Here is why the case against
Donald Trump should be dismissed:
First, The National Archives
lacked the legal authority to make a criminal referral to the
Department of Justice…
Second, NARA is bound to defer to
the former President's rights and privileges yet they ignored
them…
Third, NARA must be insulated
from White House influence, yet the Biden White House directly
shaped how the Archivist acted in response to former President
Trump…
HELP US KEEP FIGHTING THE DEEP
STATE >>
Bottom Line: Biden's DOJ betrayed
its duty, the law, and the American people's trust when it
indicted President Trump based on an unlawful criminal referral
from the National Archives. The prosecution against him in the
Southern District of Florida has no basis in law and must end.
SUPPORT AMERICA FIRST LEGAL >>
Stephen Miller
President, America First Legal

| | | After tremendous pressure from the public and its own reporters, NBC was forced to [reverse](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6690274f-4f2f-47c4-8435-d3231b8f40b0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) its hiring of former RNC Chair and repeated election denier Ronna (Romney) McDaniel as an on-air contributor. But there are still plenty of other election deniers appearing regularly across the cable news spectrum, and many of them are getting paid to spout their nonsense. [**Add your name, and tell the news channels to stop hiring election deniers.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T20d7c2a9-7e3e-47d9-8933-65749a601ccc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) This isn't about differences in opinion, it's about allowing liars to spout BS that has been disproven time and time again. A news channel airing this is like a math channel featuring "experts" who insist that 2+2=17. It's garbage, and it is an attack on our democracy and our nation, and they need to stop promoting it. | This has been a difficult week.

I wanted to give you some updates in the wake of the tragic collapse of the Francis Scott Key Bridge on Tuesday, March 26th.

Over the last few days, our teams have been working around the clock. I want to thank the Biden Administration, Governor Wes Moore, Mayor Brandon Scott, and all of Team Maryland for mobilizing so quickly and standing by our side amid these unprecedented challenges.

Our immediate focus remains on ensuring we can meet the ongoing needs of the families impacted in the wake of this unspeakable tragedy. I have spoken with them—our neighbors—and moving forward, we will continue to do all we can to provide solace, support, and grace during this unimaginable time.

As we move into the next phase of this crisis, we remain ready to do all we can to support efforts to clear the channel and get the Port back open for business. This work is complex, and it will take considerable time — and unprecedented partnership.

I again thank all our dedicated first responders for their swift and coordinated response, as well as every public servant, community hero, and committed partner who has and will continue to help us meet this moment. Together, we will show the world that we will persevere.

In service,

Johnny Olszewski

body:
Let’s prove the cynics wrong.
#
Derek, in a minute I’m going to ask you to do something important: **[Donate $5 or any amount that works for you ahead of our end-of-quarter deadline.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240330-1?refcode=em20240330-1-8880&refcode2=8880_434096_fDsFSL&akid=8880%2E434096%2EfDsFSL)**
But before I get to that, I want to tell you about an event I had the privilege of hosting earlier this week in ruby-red McKean County, PA — and how it’s a prime example of our philosophy of _**Every County, Every Vote.**_
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240330-1?refcode=em20240330-1-8880&refcode2=8880_434096_fDsFSL&akid=8880%2E434096%2EfDsFSL)
I’ve been to McKean a *bunch* since my time as Lt. Gov + during the campaign, but this time was special. You know why?
McKean is one of the reddest counties in PA — **and we still had more than a hundred people show up to our event.**
I campaigned on Every County, Every Vote in 2022. It’s how we defeated Dr. Oz + kept the Senate blue. I meant it then, and I sure as sh*t mean it now — and it’s an honor to know that Pennsylvanians are still with us.
**[This work is how we’ll keep the Senate + White House — by not taking anyone for granted. Will you pitch in $5 now to help us reach our EOQ goal before the March 31 deadline and keep up the fight in every county across PA?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240330-1?refcode=em20240330-1-8880&refcode2=8880_434096_fDsFSL&akid=8880%2E434096%2EfDsFSL)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240330-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240330-1-8880&amount=5&refcode2=8880_434096_fDsFSL&akid=8880%2E434096%2EfDsFSL)**
**[Donate another amount »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240330-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240330-1-8880&refcode2=8880_434096_fDsFSL&akid=8880%2E434096%2EfDsFSL)**
There are a *lot* of cynics who told me that visiting Democrats in tiny “red” counties is a waste of time. They said that we’d never beat the million$ in dirty super PAC money spent against us. **They were wrong then, and they’re wrong now.**
Every vote matters, every supporter matters, and donations from this grassroots-powered team is the way we’ll keep up the work.
**[I’m never going to stop fighting for folks across all 67 counties, but I need you on the team. So please, can you chip in ANY amount before the FEC deadline?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240330-1?refcode=em20240330-1-8880&refcode2=8880_434096_fDsFSL&akid=8880%2E434096%2EfDsFSL)**
Thank you!!!
John ❤️
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

clean_body: Let’s prove the cynics wrong. Derek, in a minute I’m going to ask you to do something important: But before I get to that, I want to tell you about an event I had the privilege of hosting earlier this week in ruby-red McKean County, PA — and how it’s a prime example of our philosophy of Every County, Every Vote. I’ve been to McKean a bunch since my time as Lt. Gov + during the campaign, but this time was special. You know why? McKean is one of the reddest counties in PA — and we still had more than a hundred people show up to our event. I campaigned on Every County, Every Vote in 2022. It’s how we defeated Dr. Oz + kept the Senate blue. I meant it then, and I sure as sht mean it now — and it’s an honor to know that Pennsylvanians are still with us. There are a lot of cynics who told me that visiting Democrats in tiny “red” counties is a waste of time. They said that we’d never beat the million$ in dirty super PAC money spent against us. They were wrong then, and they’re wrong now. Every vote matters, every supporter matters, and donations from this grassroots-powered team is the way we’ll keep up the work. Thank you!!! John ❤️ John Fetterman U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

I try not to send you too many messages, but as we close out the first fundraising quarter, I wanted to share some highlights of my work since I began serving Rhode Islanders in Congress.
---
Since November, I have:
* Had the pleasure of meeting with more than 1,500 constituents to hear their concerns and discuss their priorities
* Resolved 119 constituent cases to deliver for First District residents
* Cosponsored 83 of pieces of legislation and led two pieces of legislation addressing combating gun violence and human rights
* Been an active member on key committees on Foreign Affairs and Science, Space, and Technology and numerous task forces and caucuses
* Secured over $20 million in federal funds to invest directly in our First Congressional District

---
And most important of all, I’ve built a team to serve you. After five months, we’re making great strides to help our state.

body:
Derek, in a
moment, I’m going to share why I’m running for re-election, but first I am
asking:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em_casey.XtZFlJ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240330_AM1_V1_S1&amount=10&t=1003&akid=6112%2E5257348%2E5IA676 ]Can you split
$10 or
more between me and Adam Schiff to build a winning campaign capable of
taking on my billionaire-backed opponent?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em_casey.XtZFlJ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240330_AM1_V1_S1&amount=10&t=1004&akid=6112%2E5257348%2E5IA676 ]CHIP IN

Pennsylvania is my home, and it always will be.

It’s where I was born, where I grew up, and where Terese and I raised our
family.

It’s also where I started a career in public service that has always been
about fighting for Pennsylvania families.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em_casey.XtZFlJ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240330_AM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=6112%2E5257348%2E5IA676 ]Sen. Bob Casey giving a thumbs up to a young boy held by his parents

I chose to make Scranton my home because of the people. I enjoy that in
Scranton, saying “hello” or “how’s it going?” in the grocery store
checkout line always leads to an engaging conversation. Neighbors don’t
just say “hello” back and go on with their day. They’re going to tell you
about what they’re buying and about their family — and they’ll ask you
about what you’re buying and about your family, too.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em_casey.XtZFlJ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240330_AM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=6112%2E5257348%2E5IA676 ]Bob Casey smiling with folks at a grocery store

Serving the people of our Commonwealth has been my great honor, and I’m
proud of the fights we’ve won together.

I’m running for re-election because there are fights we still must win
together – like the fight for voting rights, women’s rights, and workers’
rights; the fight to lower costs for working families; and the fight for
our children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em_casey.XtZFlJ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240330_AM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=6112%2E5257348%2E5IA676 ]Bob Casey sitting at a table laughing with folks

The reality is, this is going to be my toughest race yet. My opponent is
worth hundreds of millions of dollars and will be another “yes” vote for
big corporations and the ultra-wealthy like him in the Senate. That’s why
Wall Street billionaires are trying so hard to defeat me and flip this
seat.

This is going to be one of the most expensive Senate races in the Nation,
and we have to be ready to fight back against millions upon millions in
outside spending if we’re going to win.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em_casey.XtZFlJ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240330_AM1_V1_S1&amount=10&t=1008&akid=6112%2E5257348%2E5IA676 ]With the Senate majority hinging on this seat, your support is more
important than ever. So what do you say? Will you split a donation between
my campaign and Adam Schiff to keep PA and the Senate blue?

body:
My birthday is April 1. I have almost everything I need. Help me get to Congress. That's my only wish this year.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/8b1862437764/its-me-hi-im-the-april-fool?e=3d27610f3d)
Click to Contribute (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=10194d5a7a-April+1+EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-10194d5a7a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** Lots of Jokes, But Rep. Christian Isn't One
------------------------------------------------------------
Hi. I'm Renee, Bob's Campaign Strategist. I told him to let me take the intro on this newsletter because April 1 is his birthday.

If you know Bob like I do, him being born April Fools Day is fitting. His ability to laugh at life and with his friends is one of the reasons I wanted to work with him. But, just because he can act the fool, he absolutely is not one. We need true representation in Washington. Our rights are being rolled back one by one -- my daughter's healthcare, my mom's social security that she's paid into her whole life, my friend's rights to love who they love without repercussions, a parent's right to decide what their children learn -- and I am tired of watching our current Representative show allegiance to his party and donors, not his constituents. Most of all, I wanted to work with Bob because he has his finger on the pulse of what is important for North Georgia like no one else I know. How do I know? Because he calls me and catches me up daily, telling me what I must read and what he heard. He sends texts with seemingly random messages that turn into really great ideas. Sending Bob to Congress,
making him Representative Christian, would be a gift for all of us, not a joke.

So I wanted to use this opportunity to give him some extra me time (which he will use reading more about the District, but, if I'm being honest, that's what makes him happiest) to tell you what I see and why I chose to help Bob get to Congress. We have a close partnership. He probably only talks to his wife, Fran, more often than he does me.

Fran and I tried to figure out what to get him for his birthday. The only thing we came up with is donor dollars. He truly loves what he is doing. Fighting for North Georgia the way he fought for the US in Iraq is his passion. Please help me wish Bob a happy birthday by donating to help him get the word out and get to Congress where he can continue to work for us.
Donate for Bob's Birthday (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=10194d5a7a-April+1+EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-10194d5a7a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
The only other way Fran and I know to celebrate Bob is to have a party. Save the date for April 27 and stay tuned for more details. You won't want to miss it!
The Supreme Court - SCOTUS heard arguments in the cases of the FDA V. ALLIANCE FOR HIPPOCRATIC MEDICINE and DANCO LABORATORIES, L.L.C. V. ALLIANCE FOR HIPPOCRATIC MEDICINE; otherwise known as the mifepristone case. Based on the lines of questioning, initial belief is that the court will recognize the FDAs authority and mifepristone will not be banned. The formal ruling is expected in mid-June.

In other actions the Supreme Court denied an expediated hearing for the Trump Immunity case. They have scheduled a hearing on the case for April 25. A ruling in this case is also expected in mid-June.

If you are a registered voter, who votes as a democrat, you are eligible to participate. For all the details check out @GA 6th and 7th Congressional District on Facebook.

The GOP _refused_ to hear them — but two of my colleagues and I stood in protest of Republicans’ rules, to ensure the families would be heard. That’s my job. But instead of doing _their_ jobs and trying to solve the problem, Republican legislators decided they’d rather vote to expel us from the House. There was a time not long ago when every American knew that having courage in the face of power was virtuous, and I still do. I'd love nothing more than to go back to my farm in Kentucky and raise my family in peace, but this moment calls for men and women of courage and conviction to fight for our country. I believe with every fiber of my being that America is worth saving and I'm ready to fight with everything I have to save her. With Courage, James Comer Chairman, House Oversight Committee | | | | | | | | Paid for by Comer for Congress ../../Downloads/%unsubscribeurl% |

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1049%2E791427%2Ehk90E0)

I'm writing today to urgently ask you to **[split a contribution — of $3 or any amount you can — between our re-election campaign and the campaign of my friend Summer Lee.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-mar24-summer-split.2xqnxc&refcode=em240330-1-t2&t=2&akid=1049%2E791427%2Ehk90E0)
_If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your split contribution to Summer Lee and Ilhan Omar will go through immediately:_
| | **[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/13?c0=io-em-mar24-summer-split.uohU5v&amount=3&refcode=em240330-1-t2&t=3&akid=1049%2E791427%2Ehk90E0)**
---
****
| **[CONTRIBUTE MORE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/13?c0=io-em-mar24-summer-split.uohU5v&refcode=em240330-1-t2&t=4&akid=1049%2E791427%2Ehk90E0)**
---
****
Let me explain why:
Even before her historic election to Congress in 2022, Summer has _never_ backed down from big fights with wealthy and powerful special interests who put profits before the lives of working people.
One of the consequences of that — as our movement is fully aware — is that our opponents have an obscene amount of resources at their disposal to hit back at us with.
Groups like AIPAC and their United Democracy Project super PAC are preparing to spend _$100 million_ against progressives all across the country, especially women of color like me and Summer.
Just last cycle, they spent $5 million trying to defeat Summer alone, and they're back at it here in 2024 with the same playbook to try again.
**The simple truth is that AIPAC and their billionaire donors would love nothing more than to silence the voices of two strong, progressive, Black women who have committed their lives to fighting for justice here at home and across the globe.**
With less than 48 hours to go until our March FEC deadline, and just three weeks until Summer's primary in Pennsylvania, there's never been a more urgent time to show that our progressive movement stands united and is ready to fight back with everything we've got.
**Summer Lee is an essential ally in our progressive movement's collective struggle, so please:**
**[Can you split a contribution — of $3 or any amount — between our campaign and Summer Lee's today? It's going to take a LOT of resources for us to fight back against the right wing and their super PACs, and your support is the only way we can make it happen.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-mar24-summer-split.2xqnxc&refcode=em240330-1-t2&t=5&akid=1049%2E791427%2Ehk90E0)
I know that I can speak for both Summer and myself when I say thank you for being a part of this movement, and for standing alongside us today.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-mar24-summer-split.2xqnxc&refcode=em240330-1-t2&t=6&akid=1049%2E791427%2Ehk90E0)**

PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS

body:
Here’s what I’ve been up to this quarter.
#
Peter,
At the end of last month, I went to Jeff City — our state capital and my hometown — and officially filed the paperwork to put my name on the ballot to represent Missouri in the U.S. Senate. I was honored to have a packed crowd standing with me as we kicked off this campaign.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44972?refcode=em20240330-5162&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5162%2E614464%2EBIZq4d)
**[CHIP IN TO ELECT LUCAS »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44972?refcode=em20240330-5162&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5162%2E614464%2EBIZq4d)**
I got into this race because I want to take back power for everyday people in this country — starting with working families right here in Missouri — and it’s important to me as I travel across the state to both hear from them and amplify their stories.
**Keep reading to see what I’ve been up to this quarter:**
In January, I talked with hundreds of workers at IBEW Local 1 who know how critical it is for us to make stuff in America again and put our country first in next-generation industries — things I’ll always fight for when I’m in the U.S. Senate.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44972?refcode=em20240330-5162&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5162%2E614464%2EBIZq4d)
A few weeks later, I signed the petition to get abortion rights on the ballot in Missouri. Reproductive freedom is on the line this year, and I was honored to join tens of thousands of Missourians signing on to take back our power from control-obsessed elites this November.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44972?refcode=em20240330-5162&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5162%2E614464%2EBIZq4d)
I also met up with Missouri Fire Fighters — and got to see even more of their awesome Fire Fighters For Kunce signs! Here’s what they told me that day:
**"We look for two things in a Senator: An effective leader who actually fights for us on our issues, and someone we'd trust to dive into a basement fire with us if they were in our unit. Josh Hawley is neither."**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44972?refcode=em20240330-5162&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5162%2E614464%2EBIZq4d)
Finally, in March, I had the pleasure of celebrating St. Patrick’s Day with members of IBEW Local 24. And just earlier this week, I had the opportunity to touch base with Missouri’s Machinist Union about what they need from our state’s leaders.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44972?refcode=em20240330-5162&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=5162%2E614464%2EBIZq4d)

In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to VoteVets before our first, official FEC deadline of the election year.
Before I do, I hope you’ll let me explain why your support is so critical, especially now.
A man who has never served in the Military, a man who has never served anyone but himself, a man who has no understanding of what service to our nation truly means... is running to become President and Commander in Chief.

Make no mistake: A second Trump Presidency where he directs America to abandon our democratic values and our obligations to allies and partners the world over, is the path to war, not peace.
We have served. We know the cost of war. That is why VoteVets is working so hard to defeat Trump. And emails like this to supporters like you are among the largest sources of donations that VoteVets has.
Without you, victory over Trump will be difficult. With you, we will end his march to power once and for all.
It is important that we show friend and foe alike that VoteVets has the resources we need to accomplish our objectives. After tomorrow’s FEC deadline VoteVets will be legally required to report our fundraising numbers. Everyone will be watching.
We must show strength.
So, on behalf of VoteVets, I ask you for your support.

Peter,

Four polls in a row have shown Trump tied with President Biden in Minnesota, and Trump promised personally this month to make a “heavy move” and pull ahead by November. If he does, he’ll win re-election.

But first, with our critical FEC fundraising deadline tomorrow, we have to ask: = | = | = Hilary understands that to solve our greatest challenges, we need to ensure that everyone is at the table. The work Hilary has done as Washington's Commissioner of Public Lands is proof of how we can deliver epic wins for our state together. Under Hilary's leadership, our state has kept 90% of wildfires under 10 acres, expanded economic opportunity through apprenticeship programs, and restored 600,000 acres of forest to keep the Evergreen State evergreen. These epic wins are why Hilary has earned the support of 25 labor organizations and 10 tribes, as well as community leaders across the district. Now, we need to keep up our momentum. Holder emailed yesterday about the progress we’re making toward our upcoming fundraising deadline. You know what’s at stake. In a critical election year, we’re laser-focused on fighting for the fairest maps in generations. And we have our work cut out for us. = Thank you, All On The Line \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Eric H. Holder, Jr. Date: Fri, Mar 29, 2024 Subject: Remember that feeling? Friends, I want you to take a moment with me and think about the first time you learned about gerrymandering — think about how you felt when you realized just how obviously wrong and backward it is to have such a thing in a representative democracy. If you’re anything like me, you might remember asking yourself, “How could our system allow for such blatant manipulation?” But instead of choosing to let that feeling disillusion us or make us cynical, we chose to do something about it. When President Obama and I joined forces to launch All On The Line five years ago, it was with the goal of pushing back against a broken status quo, and building a more representative democracy for all Americans.You’ve been right there with us, and that’s truly powerful. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: --- = | = = | = = | = I don’t need to be the one to tell you that partisan and racial gerrymandering offend the very notion of fairness. And I surely don’t need to be the one to tell you that the work to counter these dangerous attempts to unravel our democracy is challenging, slow, and often frustrating. But perhaps I can assure you that with a special combination of grit and grace, a movement like ours can be successful in building toward something better. That’s why I’m so grateful to have you by our side. You understand what’s at stake and are willing to do the hard work necessary to win – right along with us. = Thank you — from the bottom of my heart — for being with us. Eric H. body:
“The NRA is little more than a shell of itself.”
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240330-1&t=1&akid=505%2E587540%2E1Jd8QW)
One thing is for sure, Peter: **The once mighty NRA is on its last legs.**
What once appeared to be an unstoppable force in American politics, the NRA has seen a mass exodus of over one million members, corruption charges, and millions of dollars in legal fees — meanwhile their overall revenue dropped 52% since 2016.1
A former top NRA official told _The New York Times_ : “The NRA is little more than a shell of itself.”2
I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—but I also know that the gun lobby is scrambling to keep their influence in Congress by pouring money into the NRA’s replacements.
When I see these headlines, Peter, I know our work is far from done:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240330-1?refcode=em20240330-1&amount=5&refcode2=505_587540_1Jd8QW&akid=505%2E587540%2E1Jd8QW)
With or without the NRA, as long as there are corrupt, purchased politicians in Congress, the gun lobby will buy their votes and strike down any chance we have for common sense gun reform.
But, if we elect a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action, we can stop the scourge of gun violence in America and block the gun lobby’s agenda.
**[With the end of the fiscal quarter in 24 hours, we're looking to finish this month in a strong position so we can elect the leaders we deserve this November. Will you rush in a $5 contribution toward our $50,000 end-of-quarter fundraising goal?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240330-1?refcode=em20240330-1&amount=5&refcode2=505_587540_1Jd8QW&akid=505%2E587540%2E1Jd8QW)**
Leaders We Deserve is already playing an integral role in electing the next generation of leaders to state legislatures across the country and we’re counting on your continued support so we can keep winning from now to Election Day. There is too much on the line for us to lose.
This month, we announced our first six endorsed candidates for the 2024 election and are actively helping these campaigns reach as many voters as possible. Every dollar helps us support these grassroots campaigns where the difference between winning and losing could be as little as a few hundred votes.
Together we can give the school shooting generation a voice in public office to pass the gun reform laws we need, end mass shootings, and counter the gun lobby’s agenda.
**[We've still got a ways to go to reach our $50,000 goal before the March 31 deadline, so can you give $5 or whatever makes sense for you today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240330-1?refcode=em20240330-1&amount=5&refcode2=505_587540_1Jd8QW&akid=505%2E587540%2E1Jd8QW)**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Sydney Gallego
subject: I know Ruben won't back down.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Arizona’s a tough place to win. It’s not easy at all.
#

Peter -
This is Sydney Gallego.
I’m reaching out to ask you to support my husband Ruben as he fights to take back Arizona’s Senate seat.
If you've got a minute, let me explain why this is so important.
Arizona’s a tough place to win. It’s not easy at all. The Republican establishment sees people like Ruben, people who stand up for what’s right and put the people they represent first, as a threat.
It’s why they’ll stop at nothing, spend whatever they have to, say whatever they need to, to tear Ruben down and put Kari Lake in the Senate.
We’ve seen some of those attacks already, and it’s tough to watch the person you love get hit like that.
But I also know this: Ruben will not back down. He’s been through tougher things than a few mean tweets.
He’d do it on his own if he has to, but we’re not afraid to ask for help when we need it. And the truth is, we’re going to need your help to fight off their attacks and win this campaign.
Tomorrow Ruben is going to hit a very important deadline, his first official FEC fundraising deadline of the Election Year, and he can’t afford to fall short.
So, on behalf of Ruben, I’m humbly asking:
[**If you can afford it, will you make a $3 donation to Ruben’s campaign? The donation itself is the most important thing here, because it’s going to take a ton of people chipping in a few bucks at a time to hit these goals ahead of that FEC deadline.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar24.sAuZhx&refcode=em240330-2-160&t=1&akid=2141%2E734936%2EnlDDaF)

He’s been through tougher things than a few mean tweets. He’d do it on his own if he has to, but we’re not afraid to ask for help when we need it. And the truth is, we’re going to need your help to fight off their attacks and win this campaign. Tomorrow Ruben is going to hit a very important deadline, his first official FEC fundraising deadline of the Election Year, and he can’t afford to fall short. So, on behalf of Ruben, I’m humbly asking: If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly. | | ** | | | | | | | ** Ruben’s working incredibly hard to win this race. And no matter how much you can afford to give, we are so grateful for your support. Thank you so, so much. | Folks, I noticed a familiar face in a recent issue of _American Rifleman._ (Yes, I really read it. You’ve got to keep your friends close and enemies closer, after all.) To no one’s surprise, the NRA took out a full-page ad bashing me — and by extension, all of the folks who are a part of this movement to reform our gun laws, make progressive change, and elect the next generation of bold, young leaders. subject: Creating an economy that works for everyone
body:
Getting working people resources and relief | | | | |
---
Dear Peter,
As the wealth gap grows, it is vital that we provide working people resources and relief to ensure our families and our children have a promising future.
We on the Peninsula are the epicenter of affordability challenges. I am working to modernize federal assistance programming to accommodate the current cost of living, and to include housing costs, childcare, and health care costs.
To achieve these goals in Congress and deliver for the 15th District, I am writing to ask for your help. [**Could you make a donation deadline this weekend before my end-of-quarter fundraising deadline?**](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=360b0afec3&e=292fde286a)
And while I’m a strong proponent of our innovation economy on the Peninsula, we must ensure we are creating an economy that works for ALL our people, not only regionally but nationally.
[**Please chip in today with a contribution of $50, $150, or even $500 to support my re-election campaign.** ](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=d0988f7ec0&e=292fde286a) The maximum allowable donation per person is $3,300 per election. Thank you in advance for your continued friendship and support. **Happy Spring!**
Sincerely,
Kevin MullinCongressman, Congressional District 15

subject: I wanted to take a moment to thank you.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ALEXANDRIA OCASIO-CORTEZ FOR CONGRESS
body:
[1]Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress

Alexandria wrote a quick
note to share what our movement has been able to accomplish because of our
grassroots supporters.

[ https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240330.Z0lRed&refcode=em20240330-6113-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=6113%2E2526796%2EiHJ7W0 ]Read the note below and then click here to contribute before our
end-of-quarter fundraising deadline to help us reach our $1.5 million goal
and have the resources to power this movement.

[ https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240330.Z0lRed&refcode=em20240330-6113-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=6113%2E2526796%2EiHJ7W0 ]To our supporters and friends, I wanted to take a moment to thank you
for being a part of this movement — a people’s movement. The collective
power of your support and continued commitment to action has transformed
countless lives on both a personal and systemic level. Looking back at
just the past year, your support has allowed us to: Raise thousands of
dollars to support healthcare justice organizers, trans and LGBT+
advocacy, support for migrants, and relief efforts for everyday Americans
recovering from climate disasters, from California to Ohio to Maui, Grow
landmark support for our climate movement, adding 17 new cosponsors to the
Green New Deal, as well as develop an implementation guide to help local
governments and nonprofits apply for federal grants that meet Green New
Deal goals, Successfully push President Biden to keep pursuing student
loan debt cancellation — so far, they’ve forgiven over $132 billion for
nearly 4 million Americans — and create the Civilian Climate Corps, which
we hope to expand greatly in years to come, Be one of the original
cosponsors calling for a ceasefire — and we have worked to grow that
coalition to 66 members strong, All while providing a living wage to our
team of organizers on the ground! And there is even more to come. As we
push to hold special interests to account, fight for real action to combat
the climate emergency, and organize for change that actually centers
working people, your continued support means absolutely everything. If you
can, would you help power our fight with a contribution today? Will you
contribute your time to our organizing efforts this year? Whether you join
our volunteer effort virtually or here in New York, our people-powered
work needs your voice. I am so grateful for all this movement has done and
continues to accomplish — because of you. On behalf of my team, and our

Let me give you a few examples.
Back in 2010, I heard nearly every day a fresh example of how our health care system was utterly broken. And so I got to work with my fellow Democrats, carefully crafting a law to begin to fix what many said was unfixable. Was the result perfect? No.
But, in the Affordable Care Act, we moved a mountain that _everyone_ thought was untouchable.
**That work continues.**
I am continuing to work to lower the costs of prescription drugs. I voted to reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices, imposing a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation, and capping the price of insulin at $35 per month.
The same is true of President Biden's infrastructure law. We identified a massive problem — a need for critical investment and job creation after some tough years of inaction. So we got to work, and got it done.
**We have a lot of work ahead of us.**
When the Supreme Court and extreme Republicans came after reproductive freedom,**I voted no because my job is to protect your ability to make decisions about your body — and to keep the politicians, judges, and radical extremists out of it.** Abortions are deeply personal medical decisions that should be between someone who is pregnant and their doctor.
Together, we sent a message to the Supreme Court that Mifepristone is a safe, effective drug used for medication abortions — and should remain legal. Abortion is health care, and people have the right to make their own decisions without government interference. This should not be political whatsoever, and a strong majority of the American people agree.
**Our objectives, from supporting our veterans and protecting voting rights, to addressing ongoing affordability crises — are achievable goals — but only with your help.**

clean_body: Open eyes on a big question for 2024 | | | | I often hear from my friends and neighbors that Congress is broken and not focused on the work of the people. I understand that frustration. I can assure you that despite all the chaos you hear about I am focused on the issues that matter to you: Fortifying abortion rights, lowering prescription drug prices and the costs of health care, supporting our veterans, protecting voting rights, and addressing ongoing affordability crises. = Donate Now If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = ---|--- = | = = Let me give you a few examples. Back in 2010, I heard nearly every day a fresh example of how our health care system was utterly broken. And so I got to work with my fellow Democrats, carefully crafting a law to begin to fix what many said was unfixable. Was the result perfect? No. But, in the Affordable Care Act, we moved a mountain that everyone thought was untouchable. That work continues. I am continuing to work to lower the costs of prescription drugs. I voted to reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices, imposing a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation, and capping the price of insulin at $35 per month. The same is true of President Biden's infrastructure law. We identified a massive problem — a need for critical investment and job creation after some tough years of inaction. So we got to work, and got it done. We have a lot of work ahead of us. When the Supreme Court and extreme Republicans came after reproductive freedom,I voted no because my job is to protect your ability to make decisions about your body — and to keep the politicians, judges, and radical extremists out of it. Abortions are deeply personal medical decisions that should be between someone who is pregnant and their doctor. Together, we sent a message to the Supreme Court that Mifepristone is a safe, effective drug used for medication abortions — and should remain legal. Abortion is health care, and people have the right to make their own decisions without government interference. This should not be political whatsoever, and a strong majority of the American people agree. Our objectives, from supporting our veterans and protecting voting rights, to addressing ongoing affordability crises — are achievable goals — but only with your help. = In gratitude, Rick = | | Paid for and authorized by Citizens to Elect Rick Larsen. | This email was sent by . | | | | | Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment). [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2753315c-8ce2-46fb-9de8-482acca6ff59/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years. I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival. But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. I am still an optimist. It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that [in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’](https://default.salsalabs.org/T954a59d5-6a26-417b-842a-dc21f557e8f6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. I’m humbly asking: [Will you make a donation to my friends at 314 Action and Blue Amp Action ahead of their FEC deadline at the end of the month? They are working to elect climate scientists and climate champions at all levels of government and they can’t do this work without you. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4ecfc4ff-0582-461b-ae65-ca180a3f1370/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world. So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect. It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more. But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry. This is the most pivotal election for climate to date. My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. If these candidates win their tough races, we will secure a climate majority in Congress and in state legislatures across the country. [Our window to act is closing. So I’m asking you to act: Join me in supporting 314 Action and Blue Amp Action. Let’s elect a historic wave of Democratic scientists who will lead the fight on climate. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td3bb3e91-1227-4ca1-ac54-04263ff021e0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can . | | | | | | Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment). Peter, I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years. I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival. But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. I am still an optimist. It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that ). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. I’m humbly asking: You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world. So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect. It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more. But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry. This is the most pivotal election for climate to date. My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.

Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.

#
You probably have seen the anti-Mike Schmidt billboards all around town. We didn’t create them, but we also can’t disagree with them. Crime has spiraled out of control under the tenure of District Attorney Mike Schmidt due to his radical policies.
Need proof?
Just look at the incredible drop in jail and prison sentences since 2020. Does anyone believe that there are fewer criminals on the streets or that crime has dropped in half, or that Schmidt is doing his job?
| [Join the Fight](https://voteforvasquez.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2859120a283c12ca5aac18412&id=4929fdf82e&e=ffb5e20bef)
---
Homicides increased notably under Mike Schmidt’s time in office. Clearly criminals feel emboldened.
Drugs are out of control, yet Schmidt is prosecuting woefully few drug dealers. Why won’t he do his job and take dealers off of our streets?
But hey, this is what he said he would do. Somehow he seemed to think that by not prosecuting some crimes, all crimes would get better. His dangerous experiment has failed, and we need a change.
It’s time for a change, and I need your help to make that change. I’m running for Multnomah County District Attorney to reverse his dangerous policies, make our streets safer and give justice to victims.

Peter, I may sound like a broken record when I tell you that I’m different from most politicians, but I really mean it.

When it comes to poverty or inequality, food insecurity or housing, mental health or LGBTQ+ rights, I don’t _just_ think about policy — I think about my own experiences. **For me, Peter, policy _is_ personal. It always has been.**

I am a Black, Afro-Latino, LGBTQ+ American. I’m a product of public housing. I don't come from a political family. I am open about my own experiences with depression. I don't have fancy degrees.

**What I _do_ have is lived experience, and I am lucky to bring my viewpoint to Congress, where my unique perspective motivates much of what I do.**

Peter, I vow to never give up on these fights so that more folks like me can have a seat at the table — _but I can’t do this alone._

Many other campaigns would usually spend these next two days of the quarter scrabbling to raise a couple thousand dollars to hit a fundraising goal.
They would have to establish urgency, sometimes, sadly, it's artificial urgency. We won't do that, because...
As of last night, we did it!
We hit our goal.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Today, I'm sending you my deep gratitude and asking you to help us move my campaign into the stratosphere, if you're able.
EXTEND YOUR CONTRIBUTION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
https://linktr.ee/boblorinser [https://linktr.ee/boblorinser]
Friends,
Long ago, I committed my team to running an honest campaign. I refuse to create artificial urgency about our financial goals to entice donors. It's just not my style.
The truth is, last night, we hit our monthly and quarterly goal. We crushed it, again. I'm very proud of my team.
So, today, I'm extending our gratitude to you for your generosity, loyalty and support. Our campaign is 100% fueled by grassroots donations from everyday people who are eager for change, pitching in what they can.
I'm also asking for your help putting us over the top before April 1st so we can get a head start on Q2. We're trying to commit every dollar to defeating MAGA extremism in our rural communities.
I will continue campaigning on the issues: Medicare for All, a labor revolution, family-sustaining wages, public education, environmental protection, energy independence, defending women's rights, and an ethical foreign policy.
While doing that, we need to show strength in the primary and get ready to fight to win this fall. We need to save for TV ads.
We need to fund a robust door-to-door field program, which requires my team to nearly double our goals for Q2.
So, we need a head start.
Friends, e very contribution, above and beyond our goal, will help me defeat Rep. Jack Bergman and Donald Trump this fall. Join us.
I am very grateful.
-Bob

[] Today, I'm sending you my deep gratitude and asking you to help us move my campaign into the stratosphere, if you're able. EXTEND YOUR CONTRIBUTION [] [] Friends, Long ago, I committed my team to running an honest campaign. I refuse to create artificial urgency about our financial goals to entice donors. It's just not my style. The truth is, last night, we hit our monthly and quarterly goal. We crushed it, again. I'm very proud of my team. So, today, I'm extending our gratitude to you for your generosity, loyalty and support. Our campaign is 100% fueled by grassroots donations from everyday people who are eager for change, pitching in what they can. I'm also asking for your help putting us over the top before April 1st so we can get a head start on Q2. We're trying to commit every dollar to defeating MAGA extremism in our rural communities. I will continue campaigning on the issues: Medicare for All, a labor revolution, family-sustaining wages, public education, environmental protection, energy independence, defending women's rights, and an ethical foreign policy. While doing that, we need to show strength in the primary and get ready to fight to win this fall. We need to save for TV ads. We need to fund a robust door-to-door field program, which requires my team to nearly double our goals for Q2. So, we need a head start. Friends, e very contribution, above and beyond our goal, will help me defeat Rep. Jack Bergman and Donald Trump this fall. Join us. I am very grateful. -Bob Bob Lorinser Candidate for US Congress Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula Democrat, MI01 CONTRIBUTE [] [] Or, send a check to FRIENDS OF DR. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1289%2E135344%2EQgQOq-)

Friend --
You’ve heard us (and every other campaign) talk about the importance of the FEC deadline coming up on March 31st. Let us take you behind the scenes on what this deadline really means:
At the end of each fiscal quarter (March 31st, June 30th, September 30th, and December 31st), federal candidates are required to publicly report how much money they’ve raised, as well as how much they have in the bank. These numbers essentially provide a glimpse into how well a particular campaign is performing, and there is always a last-minute push for contributions in the period leading up to the deadline. (Hence, this email.)
In this last-minute push, campaigns tend to pull out all the stops when it comes to raising money. Some tactics try to scare the heck out of you, some are full of apocalyptic despair, and some can be downright manipulative.
Trust us, we don’t like these tactics either -- but fundraising around a deadline does actually tend to be pretty effective. Unfortunately, creating a sense of urgency and continuing to up the stakes does actually get more folks to contribute. It’s gotten to the point that some campaigns will make up fake deadlines, fake consequences, and emergency-like energy in order to continue to drive that sense of urgency.
But that approach has never been Elissa's style. So rather than giving you a completely made-up emergency or trying to convince you that the sky is falling, we just lay our cards out on the table, as we’re doing now.
Our goal is to give you the full context as to why these (actual) deadlines are important and try to give you a window in our race, and the whole process of running for Senate.
Tomorrow's FEC deadline is one of our best chances to show what a formidable opponent Team Slotkin is. Friends and competitors alike watch these numbers and make critical decisions for the road ahead.

To everyone who wants to make our communities safer from gun violence, please don't skip this short message.

This is serious, team. If we fall short, we risk sending a message that we don’t have what it takes to elect gun safety champions up and down the ballot in this year’s critical elections.
**We can’t let that happen.**

What you may not know is that GIFFORDS is funded by the donations of 1% of our supporters. Without those donations, big or small, we wouldn’t be able to do our lifesaving work.

[**If you’re ready to make an incredible impact on our movement to end gun violence, please contribute $3 to GIFFORDS PAC today, or select an amount below. Our average online donation is around $22. Some give more, others give less. body:
After Kyrsten Sinema announced she was not running for re-election, we knew we had to act fast.

| Peter -

We had to make a difficult decision recently, and I need to tell you about it — both because you deserve to know and because Ruben needs your help.

After Kyrsten Sinema announced she was not running for re-election, we knew we had to act fast.

We were expecting a decision, we were prepared for both outcomes — but when we saw the Republican response and the money Republican Senators were raising for Kari Lake we knew we had to step things up.

Our campaign launched our first television ad of the cycle — and the hope is that we can afford to stay up.

We hadn't ever really thought we would go up on the air this early, but being the only ones up gives us a huge advantage.

And the bet I made was that supporters like you — people who know the stakes of this race — would step up to help close the budget gap.

So I am asking:

[_**Can you please contribute $5 (or more if you can) split between Fight for Progress and Ruben Gallego's campaign for Senate in Arizona?
