My team told me to keep it short, so I’ll save the sermon for Sunday morning!

[**__Look, with so much on the line for November’s election, Democrats in my great state of Georgia could really use your help before their major end-of-quarter deadline, so I’m asking you to please split a donation between their team and mine before our deadline tomorrow at midnight.__**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82009813/464159989/1583625711?refcode=20240330.2_RW_3BB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYWQzOWM5OC1jNmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kJrPi9y-yJ1EqYzpzGtgI1Mq_v1xowBqJcHBuw9W5G4=) The road to the White House runs through Georgia and our democracy is on the line, but I’m sure you’ve already heard me say that. What you may not have heard me say is that I believe democracy is the political enactment of a spiritual idea. It’s this notion that each of us has within us a spark of the divine—each of us has value. And since we have value, our voices matter.

In just a few months, we’ll use our voices to vote and determine the direction of our country and our destiny within it. President Biden and Democrats up and down the ballot are committed to protecting voting rights, reproductive freedom, health care, jobs, the environment, and everything else that matters to you.

**_As a pastor, I often say that a vote is a kind of prayer for the world we desire for ourselves and for our children. Voting is one way to put your faith into action. But there are so many other ways, too—including by giving to those who share your beliefs._**

[**_So, I’m asking you tonight to give what you can if you believe in what we believe in—things like freedom, equality, diversity, and democracy. Please split a donation between my team and the Democratic Party of Georgia so we can re-elect President Biden and put some collective power behind our prayers!_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82009814/464159990/1583625711?refcode=20240330.2_RW_3BB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYWQzOWM5OC1jNmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kJrPi9y-yJ1EqYzpzGtgI1Mq_v1xowBqJcHBuw9W5G4=) Keep the faith and keep looking up,

Rev. Raphael Warnock

name: Karen Crnkovich
subject: Holiday Weekend - Important Message
body:
I hate to bother you on a holiday weekend. I wouldn't normally if this wasn't important.

This past week, the Chair of the National Republican Congressional Committee came to Kansas City to headline a fundraiser for my primary opponent. Doubling down, he went on a local talk radio show, and the only candidate he highlighted was...you guessed it, my primary opponent.

DC does not have the best track record in choosing the winning candidate. For two cycles their 'choice' lost us the election and as a result, we are represented by a leftist extremist in Congress. Yet, here they are again trying to tell us who our candidate should be.

Folks in DC do NOT vote in Kansas

[I believe elections should be earned...and I am working hard to earn your vote. You deserve a candidate picked by Kansans, not anointed by DC insiders.](https://secure.winred.com/karen-crnkovich-for-congress/donate)

**_We need a candidate in KS03 who can actually win the general election, not get a participation trophy for winning a primary._**

I'm running for Congress because you _deserve_ a candidate who will put Kansas, not DC, first.

I'm running for Congress because you _deserve_ a candidate who understands and cares about the issues you are struggling with...and has the experience, passion, and fresh ideas to tackle them.

I'm running for Congress because you _deserve_ to have a representative who will be hard-working and effective.

**But, I need your help getting there.**

Unlike my opponent, I am not being bankrolled by the DC Elite and out-of-staters. I am proud to be running a tight, efficient campaign, with the support and funding from my fellow Kansans.

[**We have an important end-of-quarter fundraising deadline tomorrow at 11:59 p.m. Please donate $25, $150, $500, or whatever you are able to today**...and help me show the DC Establishment that WE decide who represents us.](https://secure.winred.com/karen-crnkovich-for-congress/donate)

I hope you and your family have a blessed Easter.
God bless and thank you for your support,

Karen

Karen Crnkovich for Congress, KS03 ____
[www.kcforkansas.com](http://www.kcforkansas.com/) ____
913-414-4446
#teamkc

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82012209/464167829/-2059189702?refcode=email_033024_EOQ4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWUxZmNiZi1jYmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoD8RohSWfRS57Rwk_w8fz14HSJrw7j8qk4THXwpo2k=) There aren’t many people in Congress like me. I’m the daughter of two Air Force veterans from Selma, Alabama. Their families were active in the civil rights movement. I grew up in Prince William County, Virginia and still live in the house I was raised in. **I’m one of the youngest women ever elected to the state legislature, and now I’m running for Congress. body:
Friends,
I’m so proud to represent and deliver for my hometown in Congress.
Washington may be more chaotic than ever, but during my time here, I’ve built real, productive partnerships across the aisle to make progress and do good in people’s lives – especially in areas like military quality of life and data privacy.
At the same time, I’ve pushed back on extreme GOP policies when they don’t align with San Diego’s values.
At 35 years old, I’m the youngest member of House leadership, where I can directly advocate for San Diego in the rooms where decisions are made.
It’s not an easy time to get things done (and yes, I know that’s in the running for understatement of the century). We’re facing challenges from so many directions. An extreme Republican party led by an authoritarian egomaniac that refuses to govern. A coordinated, decades-long movement to roll back reproductive rights that’s gaining steam and inflicting real harm on millions of people. A gun violence crisis that’s cruelly cutting far too many lives short.
These are all fights that require our energy and our commitment.
But we’ve fought and won before, and I know we can do it again.
I’d be honored to continue serving my community and my generation in Congress, and I hope I have your support in my re-election campaign.
If I do – would you consider chipping in any amount right now to help us reach our March FEC fundraising goal? The deadline is tomorrow at midnight, and we’re so close. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you so much.
-Sara Jacobs

clean_body: Friends, I’m so proud to represent and deliver for my hometown in Congress. Washington may be more chaotic than ever, but during my time here, I’ve built real, productive partnerships across the aisle to make progress and do good in people’s lives – especially in areas like military quality of life and data privacy. At the same time, I’ve pushed back on extreme GOP policies when they don’t align with San Diego’s values. At 35 years old, I’m the youngest member of House leadership, where I can directly advocate for San Diego in the rooms where decisions are made. It’s not an easy time to get things done (and yes, I know that’s in the running for understatement of the century). We’re facing challenges from so many directions. An extreme Republican party led by an authoritarian egomaniac that refuses to govern. A coordinated, decades-long movement to roll back reproductive rights that’s gaining steam and inflicting real harm on millions of people. A gun violence crisis that’s cruelly cutting far too many lives short. These are all fights that require our energy and our commitment. But we’ve fought and won before, and I know we can do it again. I’d be honored to continue serving my community and my generation in Congress, and I hope I have your support in my re-election campaign. If I do – would you consider chipping in any amount right now to help us reach our March FEC fundraising goal? The deadline is tomorrow at midnight, and we’re so close. Unlike other generators, you'll never run out of gas. You'll have a power supply that you can recharge endlessly. And its portability is a huge advancement over chunky gas generators, or home-installed systems. You can take the Patriot Power Generator 2000X with you if you are forced out of your home. You'll have an ample supply of AC electricity available to power your fridge, freezer, or medical devices. Even your coffee maker... power your cell phones, computers, radios... and so much more. You can even use it to power an electric blanket to keep you warm. NO DEADLY FUMES, AND SILENTLY STEALTHY The Patriot Power Generator 2000X is a completely self-contained system that silently provides up to 2,000 continuous watts of totally FREE, renewable power. And it's so easy to use a child can use it. 1. Unfold and set up the solar panel in the sunlight. 2. Plug in the solar panel. 3. Now plug in your electronic devices and enjoy free power from the sun! Amazingly, it takes just 6 hours to fully charge via AC cord. It holds a charge for up to a year. PLEASE DON'T WAIT TO LEARN MORE But don't delay. We can't keep these generators in stock. Once we run out, it could be a while before we can get you one. To your survival, Frank Bates Patriot Headquarters P.S. Thanks to your support, we're able to provide support to important charities that help American veterans and their families. Charities like Fisher House, A Soldier's Child Foundation, Team Rubicon and Operation Homefront. CUSTOMERS ARE RAVING ABOUT THEIR SOLAR GENERATOR Joe B. "My Patriot Power Generator arrived four days before Ian "the beast" hurricane hit my town. It was a lifesaver. After losing all power, we would have been in absolute darkness with no way to communicate to the outside world. If we needed aid or rescue, it would have been impossible with dead phone batteries. The Patriot Power Generator was everything you said it was and more. I say this with tears in my eyes: I'll never be without at least one. Great product, people! You should be proud!" Bob A. "Could not be happier! Generator works flawlessly, solar works flawlessly, plus all the other goodies in the package are amazing! Would definitely recommend 4Patriots for all your generator and other survival needs! Just spoke with Sienna at customer service to say how much I love the products! Sienna was very courteous and professional!" Carla U. "The ice storms in February left us without any type of electricity for a solid week. If it wasn't for the solar generator, my husband wouldn't have been able to sleep with his CPAP and we would have been in the dark for a week. It was very helpful and very convenient to be able to keep it charging continuously by day in the sun. It's well worth the money. Get off the fence and order this for the safety and security of your family!" Bernice L. "Don't wait to add this vital piece of equipment to your preparedness arsenal! We were able to keep our lights on and our electronic equipment charged for 5 days when the power went out last year. As soon as we could, we purchased another generator!" Patricia T. "This is great not just emergencies, but everyday help as well! I needed to repair my shed, but there's no power out there, and most of my tools are plug-in electric. I was unhappily thinking about running 150ft of extension cords, then remembered my 4Patriots Solar Generator! Worked like a charm. Utterly reliable and easy to use. There's no good reason to put off getting back-up power! Peace of mind and convenience, too! Love it!"

| Peter, when I first ran for Congress in 1994, I was **publicly outed as gay by my Republican opponent, Ken Calvert.**

**Today, I wanted to show you the exact mailers that were used:** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82015023/464177478/314310606?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20240330_EMDF_E2_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMzcwZjZhZS1kNWVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w60tAHuqn7Uv_JyJbYBNJZ_E1CMbuIVIB6xIRitcviE=) Peter, in a series of bright pink mailers, Ken Calvert – _a currently sitting US Congressman_ – **revealed my sexuality to thousands of Riverside residents without my consent.**

Hi again, Derek! It's Bart, Chrissy's husband.
Right now, Chrissy's up against her end-of-quarter fundraising deadline – her last one before the primary – and I wanted to reach out to share why that's so important.
**For the 30 years I've stood by Chrissy's side, she's never ceased to amaze me.**

Today is National Doctors’ Day, a day meant to celebrate doctors everywhere for their unwavering support and commitment to providing quality healthcare to their communities.

It’s this drive that led her to run for office, so she could bring her expertise as a doctor to Congress and help drive action on how to best bring affordable care to every American.

This monumental achievement not only secured our position on the ballot but also paved the way for the citizens of Alaska to voice their desire for change.****The journey to this pivotal moment has been fueled by a year of relentless effort, strategic networking, and a deep commitment to our cause. Our volunteers have traversed every corner of Alaska, engaging with communities, explaining the complexities of RCV, and illuminating the benefits of a more direct voting system. This grassroots campaign has not only expanded our network but has also significantly raised awareness about the issues surrounding RCV.****As we stand on the brink of this historic opportunity, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has contributed to this cause. Your support has been the backbone of our campaign, providing us with the resources, energy, and motivation needed to confront and dismantle the RCV system in Alaska.****The early news release confirming our achievement marks not just a milestone for our movement but also a beacon of hope for those who believe in electoral reform. This is our chance to fundamentally transform Alaska's electoral landscape, ensuring a voting system that is straightforward, understandable, and truly reflective of the people's will.****Let's seize this moment and make history together. The ballot is our battleground, and with your continued support, we will achieve our goal of ridding Alaska of Ranked Choice Voting. The fight is far from over, but with our collective strength, determination, and the foundation we've built over the past year, victory is within our reach. Thank you, Alaska, for standing with us.****Together, we will restore simplicity and clarity to our elections, ensuring a future where every vote counts in the most straightforward manner possible. Let's move forward, united in our purpose and resolute in our mission to eliminate Ranked Choice Voting. The time for change is now, and with your help, we will make it a reality.**

### **Press Release**
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****Alaska Volunteers Triumph: Nearly 43,000 Signatures to Overturn Ranked Choice Voting** _**Anchorage, Alaska**_**– In a resounding demonstration of democratic engagement, a grassroots movement led by over 700 Alaskan volunteers has successfully gathered nearly 43,000 signatures, significantly exceeding the required 26,000, to propose the removal of Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) in Alaska. This monumental effort was completed a full month ahead of schedule, showcasing the determination and unity of Alaskans.****"This is not just a collection of signatures, but a profound statement by the people of Alaska," said Phil Izon, a lead organizer of the initiative. "Our volunteers, all Alaskans, have voiced their concerns and desires through this campaign. We've surpassed the number of signatures the Pro-RCV group initially gathered to introduce RCV, underlining a growing skepticism and desire for change among the electorate."****The movement has been a true grassroots effort, contrasting sharply with the Pro-RCV group, which reportedly spent over $7 million and relied on out-of-state resources to promote and push RCV on Alaska. "Our success was driven by Alaskans, for Alaskans. We did not need to fly in people or spend millions. Our strength came from the genuine support and hard work of our volunteers," Izon added.****This initiative represents a significant challenge to RCV, a system that has been increasingly scrutinized for its complexity and the perception that it obscures the straightforward principle of "one person, one vote." The organizers believe that this successful petition drive will resonate beyond Alaska, setting a precedent for other states considering RCV, we are a cautionary tale (Like a canary in coal mine, warning others about danger).****"We stand for the Alaskans who felt misled, for those who found the RCV ballot confusing, and for everyone who believes in the sanctity of the straightforward voting process," said Izon. "Our message is clear: it's time to remove Ranked Choice Voting from our state. 'Let's Take Out The Trash, Let’s Rid The Rank' is more than a slogan; it's a call to action for all Alaskans who value transparency and simplicity in their electoral system."****The submitted signatures will now undergo verification by state officials. When validated, this will pave the way for a ballot measure where Alaskans can directly vote on the future of RCV in their state.****"We did this for you, for every Alaskan who wants their vote to count in the most direct and understandable way. We urge all Alaskans to stand with us and vote to remove Rank Choice Voting. Together, we can ensure our electoral system reflects the true will of the people," concluded Izon.**

"Our success was driven by Alaskans, for Alaskans. We did not need to fly in people or spend millions. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I am taking this very seriously:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Because we need to take this race very seriously.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1990%2E4032634%2EYbgT1c)
---
Tomorrow’s FEC deadline is the most important moment of my re-election campaign yet. I’d like to explain why: This will be the first time we publicly report our fundraising numbers since a Republican challenger jumped in the race. This challenger was recruited from outside Massachusetts, has pledged $500,000 of his own money to his campaign, and can invite national Republicans, billionaires, and corporate interests to invest in getting me — and the plans we’re fighting for — out of office. We know that national Republicans will do anything to take away our Senate majority and pass Trump’s extremist policies — like a national abortion ban. We know that billionaires will use their piles of money to stop politicians who are fighting to make them finally pay their fair share in taxes. And we know that wealthy corporate interests will support any political agenda that means less accountability, less oversight, and less taxes for them. They’ll be looking at our public fundraising report to gauge just how strong we are. So let’s show them what they’re up against: [**If you’re able to make a contribution to support my re-election campaign today, will you contribute $28 or any amount? Your contribution will help demonstrate the strength of our grassroots campaign to our opponents — and secure the resources we need to compete against these outside interests.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1965?amount=28&t=8&akid=1990%2E4032634%2EYbgT1c)

---
_If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_ |

---

Yes, 2024 is about keeping Trump out of the White House. That is a top priority. But it’s also about making sure Democrats can defeat Republicans _everywhere._ It’s about the policies we’re fighting for, and the people who those policies benefit. That’s why I’m fighting for policies like universal child care, taxing the rich, and making the Supreme Court follow a standard code of ethics. Policies that put power in the hands of working people instead of benefiting the wealthy and powerful. I’m taking this FEC fundraising deadline seriously because — and I want to be clear — we need to take this race very seriously. Because we can’t underestimate the amount of support my opponent will receive from national Republicans and special interests. We can’t underestimate the threat of Republicans controlling the Senate, passing a national abortion ban, and other extremist items on Donald Trump’s agenda. And we can’t underestimate what would happen if our progressive movement for universal child care, big bank regulations, and taxing the rich did not have a voice in Congress. [**Unlike my opponent, this campaign is funded by grassroots donors. So if you’re able, I need you to pitch in $28 or anything you can right now before midnight tomorrow so we can demonstrate our movement’s strength on our upcoming FEC fundraising report.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1964?t=14&akid=1990%2E4032634%2EYbgT1c) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

I am so proud and so excited to lead the charge against one of America’s most extreme and dangerous members of Congress, Jim Jordan.

In over 18 years in Congress, and 12 years before that in the Ohio legislature, Jordan has done literally NOTHING to benefit us. **He has never passed a single bill in Congress—not one. Single. Bill.

****_Jordan has served nearly two decades in Congress and has nothing to show for it.

_** I am working hard to tell every voter in this district that I am _already_ doing the job that Jordan is incapable of: **I am drafting 9 bills that I will introduce on Day 1 as a member of Congress.

clean_body: | | I’m proud to lead the charge against Jordan and for a better world. | | | | | Friend, I am so proud and so excited to lead the charge against one of America’s most extreme and dangerous members of Congress, Jim Jordan. In over 18 years in Congress, and 12 years before that in the Ohio legislature, Jordan has done literally NOTHING to benefit us. He has never passed a single bill in Congress—not one. Single. Bill. Jordan has served nearly two decades in Congress and has nothing to show for it. I am working hard to tell every voter in this district that I am already doing the job that Jordan is incapable of: I am drafting 9 bills that I will introduce on Day 1 as a member of Congress. More concerning, Jordan is a serious threat to our national security. We still don’t know what role he played in enabling and planning the deadly January 6 Capitol riot, since he ignored and defied a lawful subpoena for information from the January 6 Committee issued on May 12, 2022. subject: Jeffrey Yass just added billions to Trump’s net worth

body:
Right-wing billionaire Jeffrey Yass is expanding his empire. | | | Peter, Right-wing billionaire Jeffrey Yass is expanding his empire. After his failed attempts to defeat WFP champions Kendra Brooks and Nicolas O’Rourke in Philadelphia last year, Yass has set his sights on Rep. Summer Lee and other progressives nationwide in 2024. He's already donated $46 million to right-wing groups and corporate Democrats this cycle.1 **But that’s not even the most concerning move he’s made recently.** Last week, Yass’ hedge fund helped arrange an acquisition of Trump’s social media company, Truth Social, resulting in an immediate _$4 billion increase_ in wealth for the disgraced former president.2 It’s not enough that he’s spending a fortune to try and unseat working-class candidates around the country. He's now trying to make his way back into Trump’s good graces, and is rumored to be a front-runner for Treasury Secretary in a Trump White House.3 **[These are the kinds of threats we’re up against this year: unprecedented attacks against WFP candidates fueled by GOP megadonors like Jeffrey Yass. And in order to fight back and defend our champions, we need resources. That’s why we’re asking you to make a donation before our end-of-quarter grassroots fundraising deadline tomorrow. clean_body: Right-wing billionaire Jeffrey Yass is expanding his empire. | | | Peter, Right-wing billionaire Jeffrey Yass is expanding his empire. After his failed attempts to defeat WFP champions Kendra Brooks and Nicolas O’Rourke in Philadelphia last year, Yass has set his sights on Rep. Summer Lee and other progressives nationwide in 2024. He's already donated $46 million to right-wing groups and corporate Democrats this cycle.1 But that’s not even the most concerning move he’s made recently. Last week, Yass’ hedge fund helped arrange an acquisition of Trump’s social media company, Truth Social, resulting in an immediate $4 billion increase in wealth for the disgraced former president.2 It’s not enough that he’s spending a fortune to try and unseat working-class candidates around the country. He's now trying to make his way back into Trump’s good graces, and is rumored to be a front-runner for Treasury Secretary in a Trump White House.3 The strategy of GOP megadonors like Jeffrey Yass is one of attrition. They failed to defeat our champions in Philadelphia last year, but could spend even more the next time they’re up for re-election. They failed to defeat Rep. Summer Lee in PA-12 last cycle,but this year are spending even more to try and unseat her. So far, Yass has failed to defund public education, ban abortion, or enact tax cuts for Pennsylvania’s wealthiest citizens. But the candidates that his PAC is supporting this year are championing those very same causes. And now, after these previous attempts were thwarted by sensible and passionate voters at the polls, he’s trying to put Trump back in the White House and MAGA back in control of the entire federal government. Jeffrey Yass — like so many other far-right billionaires — has bottomless pockets. And we know he’s just getting started this cycle. We can’t let super PACs and right-wing billionaires like Yass drown out our candidates' voices. But in order to do our best door-to-door and face-to-face organizing, we need the resources to make sure we reach as many voters as possible. We may not have billions to spend like the other side does. But pound-for-pound, dollar-for-dollar, we have the power to out-organize them. We've proven that our ideas, values, and candidates CAN win. But only with your support. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , Axios, March 21, 2024 2\. , Sludge, March 25, 2024 3\. , New York Post, March 14, 2024 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran-Owned small businesses**
* **Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation**
* **Passed a resolution affirming strong US support for Ukraine**
* **Passed legislation to support mental health for school children**

Fellow Patriot,

I hope this email finds you enjoying Holy Saturday with your family. **I am so sorry to bother you** , but I wanted to let you know that our campaign has our [end of quarter financial](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=d57bd940a7&e=c00a6982d2)[ deadline](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=1844e69c69&e=c00a6982d2)[ ](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=a190ad1fb1&e=c00a6982d2)this Sunday.

Our campaign has incredible momentum, and [we need your help](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=60350fd5b3&e=c00a6982d2) to keep that momentum going. [Please consider making a donation before midnight on Easter Sunday](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=c8f5967a6e&e=c00a6982d2).

[If we have the resources](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=bfc37955c2&e=c00a6982d2), we will beat the establishment politicians and bring a reckoning to the Jefferson City Swamp.

Thank you for taking the time to read this email. I pray that you and your loved ones have a wonderful Resurrection Sunday, and I ask you to join Amanda and me in lifting up our country in prayer.

Let us take heart in knowing that no matter what we may face, the Risen Christ sits on the throne.

Sunday is coming! _But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified. He is not here, for he has risen, as he said. Come, see the place where he lay."
Matthew 28:5-6_

body:
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots. I think that anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate. |
---
I won’t ever forget it, Peter.

Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.

I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.

And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick.

Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.

I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.

This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.
